subject: Re: Purchase order cadence and payment terms request
messages:
From: Lisa Chen <l.chen@novapulse.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@novapulse.com
Date: Thu, 5 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Purchase order cadence and payment terms request

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — NovaPulse is excited about Redwood. Procurement has a few constraints we need to capture before legal prepares the SOW:

- We issue consolidated monthly invoices (one invoice per month for all usage).
- Standard payment terms: Net 90.
- PO required for each quarterly commitment (we can supply PO numbers up front but require the PO reference on every invoice).
- Invoicing must include GL codes and a NovaPulse procurement contact in the invoice header.
- We prefer electronic invoicing via our supplier portal (invoice upload or cXML).

Can Redwood confirm you can support: monthly consolidated invoices, Net 90, PO field on invoices, and GL code mapping? If there are exceptions (Net 60/45, or quarterly invoices) please propose them and any required commercial offsets (discount, deposit).

Example: our initial committed SKU will be Redwood-Pro 4x GPUs, 12-month term; we can provide PO #45321 when the SOW is ready.

Thanks,
Lisa Chen
Senior Procurement Manager
NovaPulse Health

--
Procurement: procurement@novapulse.com
From: aditya.rao@redwood.com
To: Lisa Chen <l.chen@novapulse.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 6 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Purchase order cadence and payment terms request

Lisa — appreciate the clear list. Short answers up front: we can support monthly consolidated invoices and PO references on every invoice. Net 90 as-is is challenging for a small vendor economics-wise, but we want to be flexible.

Proposal options:
- Option A (preferred): Net 60 with monthly consolidated invoices. In exchange, NovaPulse signs a 12-month committed capacity schedule (the commitment you outlined) and we apply a 5% volume discount.
- Option B: Net 90 with an upfront 30% prepayment on the first invoice (applied against first 3 months).
- Option C: Net 90 without prepayment, but Redwood can offer a 3% early-pay discount if payment arrives within 15 days.

We can include GL code fields and a procurement contact on the invoice. For e-invoicing, we support SFTP upload of PDF batches today and are piloting cXML for a subset of customers — we can explore a cXML onboarding plan if you prefer.

Marissa / Karthik — flagging for commercial ops: is Net 60 + 5% acceptable to revenue ops for a 12-month committed seat/throughput deal? Also any constraints on releasing the first invoice before PO is in the portal?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0189
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 9 Feb 2026 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Purchase order cadence and payment terms request

Aditya — quick read: net 60 + 5% for a 12-month commit is reasonable but requires two things from legal/finance:
1) Add a clause that invoices unpaid after net terms will incur interest at 1.25% per month (standard), and
2) We need a signed PO acknowledgement and a purchase order number before provisioning starts for dedicated capacity.

Operational notes: we can populate GL mapping fields on the invoice PDF. For cXML, our product integrations team will need at least a 4-week lead time.

If NovaPulse absolutely insists on Net 90, the 30% prepayment option is acceptable only with finance sign-off; otherwise push for the 3% early pay.

I'll approve Net 60 w/ 5% if they sign the 12-month commitment and provide PO #45321 prior to go-live.

- Marissa
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
From: aditya.rao@redwood.com
To: Lisa Chen <l.chen@novapulse.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:50:00 -0800
Subject: Terms proposal for PO #45321 and invoicing cadence

Lisa — following internal review, here is a concise restatement of the options so procurement can pick the path that works:

1) Net 60 + monthly consolidated invoices (preferred)
   - 12-month committed capacity schedule (we will include committed SKUs in SOW).
   - 5% committed-volume discount applied to monthly invoices.
   - PO #45321 must be provided and referenced on each invoice; provisioning occurs after PO acknowledgement.
   - Redwood will include a GL code field and procurement contact in the invoice header.

2) Net 90 + 30% prepayment on first invoice
   - Prepayment applied against first 3 months of charges.
   - Monthly invoices thereafter with PO reference.

3) Net 90 without prepayment
   - Redwood will offer 3% early-pay discount if invoice paid within 15 days.

Other operational details: we can deliver invoices via SFTP (PDF batches) immediately; cXML onboarding is possible but requires ~4 weeks. Invoices unpaid beyond terms will accrue 1.25% monthly interest. We will provide a W-9 and SOC 2 report as part of the procurement package.

Please confirm which option you prefer and attach the PO when convenient. If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-minute call with Marissa and Karthik to walk through GL fields and the SFTP/portal process.

Best,
Aditya
From: Lisa Chen <l.chen@novapulse.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@novapulse.com
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 14:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Terms proposal for PO #45321 and invoicing cadence

Aditya — thanks for the clarity. NovaPulse prefers Option 1 (Net 60 + monthly consolidated invoices) and will sign the 12-month commitment. We will provide PO #45321 tomorrow. A few follow-ups:

- Can you confirm the exact invoice header fields you require for GL mapping? We need field names so our ERP team can populate them.
- SFTP delivery is fine. Please send the SFTP endpoint and instructions for testing.
- Please attach the W-9 and SOC 2 cover letter.

We accept the 1.25% interest on late payments as standard. Once we receive the invoice template we will have our AP team confirm the header mapping.

Regards,
Lisa
